lines.en: Would you like to respond?
What would you like to say?
: Sorry to be the bearer of bad news but...no.
: That could have been the easiest lie of your life nope fuck Imani I guess.
: Do you really care that much?
: OBVIOUSLY. Do you think I'd be a student for Halloween if I was comfortable with how quickly I am DYING?
: One thousand yen says I'm dying faster.
: That does not make my impending death any better!
: In fact, it makes it worse because you were going to be the one to give my eulogy!
: Why me?
: Because Rika is an idiot, Wakana is too gloomy, and Osako is too busy fawning over how gloomy Wakana is.
: Have Kirin do it.
: Kirin would straight crawl into my coffin and fuck my dead body.
: And I wouldn't?
: O_o
: You know maybe I'll just pre-record my own eulogy and have somebody play the tape.
: Where'd you even get that uniform?
: Custom ordered BIATCH.
: I thought the school refused to let you get one.
: I may have fabricated an application for a new uniform on behalf of a certain delinquent.
: Imani...
: WHAT she wasn't going to submit one and this was my only chance!
: You could have just gotten one with different colors.
: But then I wouldn't fit in and the girls wouldn't acknowledge me as one of their own!
: They acknowledge Yasu and her colors are black and white.
: Okay, but, let's be real. Do they REALLY acknowledge Yasu??? Or do they just let her exist
: Sounds like a form of acknowledgement to me.
: Say, when are you going to get a cool new uniform? I want to see you in our colors.
: I think you could pull it off. And I'm not just saying that because I've got a thing for dudes in uniforms.
: Which I do just FYI.
: Same.
: Bro you gay???
: Sorry, I meant girls in uniform.
: Awww Senpai :D
: Sorry, I meant girls in uniforms they did not acquire via dubious means.
: Awww Senpai D:
: Imani, you're like 20.
: I'm older than 20 but even THAT is too old! I want to be 15 again!
: Why in the world would anyone ever want that?
: Because being an adult fucking SUCKS man we've gotta pay taxes and sign our name on a bunch of shit.
: If I was 15, all I'd have to sign my name on would be tests. Tests that I'd get an A on since you'd be my teacher.
: How come you get to revert to a younger age but I have to stay the same?
: Hey if you can figure out a way to get both of us back to 15 I will gladly resume this friendship in our smaller forms.
: But if just one of us is going back, I call shotgun.
: But don't worry, we can still chill. I'm sure YOU wouldn't mind.
: Ha.
: All seriousness though, I wonder if we would have been friends if we went to school together.
: Guessing you'd be the gloomy kid sitting in the back of the classroom.
: Omg which would mean I would be the super popular girl who starts hanging out with you despite everyone being like UHHH IMANI WHY HE IS WEIRD
: And then you'd be all like I HAVE A DARK PAST
: And I'd be all like I CAN FIX YOU
: Then we'd bang or something idk
: You should write a book.
: And you should invent a time machine.
